reason: Governance capture of a dormant Compound-style DAO by one voter who buys enough tokens to clear a fixed absolute quorum/threshold, then executes a malicious proposal or takes Timelock admin.
Uniswap V3 LP vault mint/burn valued at instantaneous slot0 with no TWAP/deviation guard, letting a flash-loan swap skew the token mix (Gamma Hypervisor is the closest code shape).
Float's Hypervisor is Gamma code; deposit/withdraw price shares via pool.slot0() so a same-tx swap moves the share valuation, exactly the Gamma incident and other spot-slot0 pricing exploits.

Uniswap V4 hook whose settlement path trusts the pool's instantaneous getSlot0 price and is callable by anyone, so a flash-moved spot lets escrowed ETH be swept; VTSwapHook is the nearest V4-hook pricing precedent.

A router/Safe-module path whose caller authorization can be spoofed (self-referential multicall or payload-supplied identity) so an unprivileged caller executes with the router's trusted identity against a Gnosis Safe.

ERC-404/hybrid token where transfer() reinterprets a small amount as an NFT id and moves a whole unit, abused against a whitelisted AMM pool via flash swaps; the 404/314 incidents share the dual-interpretation token design.
Public function takes a caller-supplied payer address and safeTransferFrom()s from it with no msg.sender/consent check, draining anyone holding a standing allowance to the contract.
Reward/dividend accounting that credits the same inflow repeatedly because the checkpoint (lastETHBalance) is only refreshed on a non-zero claim, so a donated delta is re-counted on empty claims.
Yearn-style vault whose share price is derived from a Curve/Convex staked balance at spot virtual_price that a depositor can inflate within a tx, enabling a deposit/withdraw NAV sandwich.

Lending-market oracle that reads an ERC4626 wrapper's convertToAssets() rate, which a direct underlying donation inflates, so collateral is overvalued and the market drained (Resupply and Venus wUSDM are the same donation pattern).

Permissionless entrypoint forwards caller-supplied calldata verbatim to a privileged target (PositionManager.multicall), letting anyone make the contract setApprovalForAll/transfer the LP NFTs it custodies.
